capabilities: Render dated notes as draggable events in calendar, timeline, heatmap, and Gantt views
Generate real notes for recurring events with virtual previews of future instances
Sync with CalDAV and ICS calendars from services like Google, Outlook, and Nextcloud
Track planned vs actual time with a built-in timer, capacity tracking, and statistics
Automate event creation and queries through a programmatic API and presets
extras: Freemium model: core features are free; Pro unlocks CalDAV/ICS URL sync, Gantt, Heatmap, Dashboard, AI chat, and the scripting API with a 30-day trial. Development happens in a private monorepo; this repo is a read-only mirror licensed AGPL-3.0. Documentation, FAQ, and video walkthroughs live outside the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize, schedule, or plan around notes that carry dates; users must leave the vault or use basic calendar navigation.

relations.evidence: Prisma Calendar is built using FullCalendar, a powerful and flexible JavaScript calendar library.
Pair with Templater for template-driven workflows.

summary: Calendar and planning plugin that turns dated notes into draggable events with calendar, timeline, heatmap, and Gantt views.
